summary: Frontend-only verification of Check-In v2.13 (CR-385) refinements. v2.13 loaded, no JS console errors. CHANGE 1 (2-col facts) PASS. CHANGE 2 (checkout-consistent white pills, no black) PASS. CHANGE 3 (Confirm pinned visible at 1920x800) FAIL — Confirm button clips below viewport and requires OUTER panel scroll to reach; ci-pane-body internal scroll works but the whole check-in modal is too tall for a 1920x800 viewport. v2.12 regressions (focus retention, pill-disabled-at-0, Card→Txn/UTR relabel, checkout bills 103/107) all pass.

ui_bugs.issue: At 1920x800, the pinned footer (Cancel + Confirm + readiness) is not visible without scrolling the outer .panel. Confirm rect top=806, bottom=842 (viewport height=800); outer .panel is scrollable (scrollH 1096, clientH 638, needsScroll=true). ci-pane-body internal scroll works (verified 0→200) and .ci-pane-foot exists, but ci-pane max-height (514px) + page header layout push the pane bottom to y=871, past the 800px viewport. Requirement was 'visible WITHOUT scrolling the outer panel'.

issues: Selected Check-In pill background is rgb(250, 250, 250) (off-white #FAFAFA) while checkout .pm button.on is rgb(255, 255, 255) (pure white). Both share the same dark inset ring (box-shadow: rgb(26,26,26) 0 0 0 1px inset), 1px solid rgb(26,26,26) border and fontWeight 700. Practically consistent but not pixel-identical — consider aligning to pure white for exact parity.

action_items: Fix CHANGE 3: at 1920x800 the pinned footer with Confirm/Cancel/readiness sits below viewport because the check-in modal + surrounding page chrome exceed 800px. Options for main agent: (a) reduce ci-pane max-height (via fitCheckin() setting --ci-height based on window.innerHeight minus header offset), (b) allow ci-pane-body min-height smaller so foot always stays within visible outer .panel, (c) make .ci-pane-foot position:sticky bottom:0 within .panel so it remains visible when outer .panel scrolls. Currently --ci-height CSS var is empty ('') and panes fall back to max-height:514px which is too tall for a 1920x800 viewport.
Optional CHANGE 2 polish: align selected Check-In pill background to rgb(255,255,255) to exactly match checkout .pm button.on (currently rgb(250,250,250)).
critical_code_review_comments: fitCheckin() does not appear to be setting --ci-height on :root (computed value is empty string). Investigate whether the fit routine actually runs or whether it targets a scoped element.
Bounded pane max-height fallback (514px) is not viewport-aware; on shorter desktop viewports the pinned footer overflows.

success_rate.frontend: 2 of 3 v2.13 changes PASS; all v2.12 regressions PASS

context_for_next_testing_agent: v2.13 changes 1 & 2 verified. Change 3 (pinned Confirm visible at 1920x800) is failing because ci-pane max-height 514px + outer chrome overflows viewport. Verify fitCheckin() sets --ci-height CSS var (currently blank) and that .ci-pane-foot remains within the outer .panel client area.
rca of the issue: At 1920x800: outer .panel has scrollH=1096 clientH=638 (needs scroll). .ci-pane elements have max-height:514px (from CSS fallback since --ci-height is empty), so pane bottom lands at y=872 while viewport ends at 800. The .ci-pane-foot containing Confirm sits at y=759..871, clipping the Confirm button (y=806..842) below the fold. Fix: make fitCheckin() actually compute --ci-height = window.innerHeight - checkinTopOffset - safeMargin, or make .ci-pane-foot position:sticky bottom:0 within the outer scrolling container.
